1: I will call upon the LORD,
Who is worthy to be praised;
So shall I be saved from my enemies.
2: I will wait upon the LORD;
He will fill me with new strength.
I will fly on wings like an eagle.
3: I will look upon the LORD;
He will make His face to shine on me.
chorus: The LORD liveth and blessed be the Rock,
And let the God of my salvation be exalted.
The LORD liveth and blessed be the Rock,
And let the God of my salvation be exalted.
Coda: I will call upon the LORD.

title: I Will Call upon the LORD
